name: Yes Networks
notes:
Yes Networks (AS273280) - Regional Cable/DSL/ISP in Guanajuato, Mexico.

PEERING POLICY: Open. No ratio, no minimum traffic, no contract required. IPv4 and IPv6. We peer on route servers.

IRR:  LACNIC::AS273280:AS-YESNETWORKS
RPKI: All announced prefixes are covered by valid ROAs.

IPv4 NOTE: Our IPv4 space is leased and therefore does not appear under AS273280 in RIR whois. Four /24s are leased from Cogent and one /24 from Huna. Route objects and ROAs for these prefixes are maintained by the address holders and authorize AS273280 as origin. Please build filters from our as-set rather than from RIR allocation data.

Suggested max-prefix: 20 IPv4 / 20 IPv6.

Peering requests: peering@yesnet.mx
NOC: noc@yesnet.mx
